scenes.name: BREAKFAST
lines: Dublin, 1843. Every morning, Hamilton's sons asked: can you multiply triplets yet?
1843 年，都柏林。每天早上，哈密顿的儿子们都问：爸爸，三元数能乘了吗？
He shook his head: no, I can only add and subtract them.
他摇摇头：不能，我只会把它们相加、相减。
Today, arrows in space do have a product: the cross product. Why isn't that enough?
可如今空间里的箭头明明有乘法，就是叉乘。为什么还不够？

scenes.name: WHAT THE CROSS DROPS
lines: Take two arrows: a is one, two, two, length three; b is zero, three, four, length five.
Their cross product stands up out of their plane. Its length is their area, about five point four.
它们的叉乘从两者的平面里竖起来，长度就是两者撑开的面积，约 5.4。
Now square everything: fifteen squared is two twenty-five, the area squared only twenty-nine. Where did the rest go?
现在全部平方：15² 是 225，面积的平方却只有 29。剩下的去哪了？
Into the dot product: a's length times b's shadow on a, which makes fourteen. The cross product throws it away.
去了点积里：a 的长度乘以 b 在 a 上的影子，得 14。叉乘把它扔掉了。
Worse, any arrow crossed with itself gives zero, so you can never divide.
更糟的是：任何箭头与自己叉乘都得零，于是没法做除法。

scenes.name: AN HONEST RECEIPT
lines: Think of a product as a receipt. In an honest one, the squared lines add up to length times length, squared.
把乘积想成一张收据：老实的收据，各行平方相加，等于长度之积的平方。
One ninety-six plus twenty-nine is two twenty-five, which is fifteen squared.
Lean checks it for any two lists of real numbers: lengths squared, multiplied, minus the dot squared, is the sum of squared areas.
Lean 内核检验了：对任意两组实数，长度平方之积减去点积平方，等于各块面积的平方和。
In three dimensions those areas are the cross product. Dot and cross: two legs of one right triangle.
在三维里，这些面积正是叉乘的分量。点积与叉乘，是同一个直角三角形的两条直角边。
The cross product is not wrong. It is half a receipt.
叉乘没有错，它只是半张收据。

scenes.name: ONE MORE LINE
lines: Hamilton's fix: give the receipt one more line, a plain number beside the arrow.
哈密顿的办法，是给收据添一行：在箭头旁边留一个普通的数。
Multiply a and b again: the number line gets minus fourteen, the arrow lines the cross product.
再把 a 和 b 乘一次：数的那一行记下 −14，箭头那三行记下叉乘。
Length fifteen, exactly three times five. Nothing leaks, and an arrow squared is minus nine, not zero.
长度 15，恰好 3 乘 5，一分不漏。箭头自乘现在是 −9，不再是零。
To multiply in three, keep a fourth.
要在三维里乘得拢，就得留住第四行。

scenes.name: THE CROSS IS FORCED
lines: Lean also checks a second fact, on one number slot and three arrow slots.
Lean 内核还检验了另一件事：取一个数位、三个箭头位。
Any twisting rule obeying two axioms, positivity and phase balance, must be the cross product, up to sign.
任何满足正性与相位平衡两条公理的扭转规则，都必定是叉乘，至多差一个整体符号。
And Pauli matrices multiply this way: the dot in the number slot, the cross in the arrow slots.
泡利矩阵正是这样相乘：点积坐在数位上，叉乘坐在箭头位上。

scenes.name: WHAT IT DOES NOT SAY
lines: No three-dimensional real number system lets you divide: Frobenius for associative products, Hurwitz when lengths multiply, Hopf in general.
实数上没有能做除法的三维数系：弗罗贝尼乌斯证了乘法可结合的情形，胡尔维茨证了长度相乘的情形，霍普夫证了一般情形。
Those are literature results. Here Lean checks only the identity and the forced cross product.
这些是文献结果；这里 Lean 只检验了那条恒等式和被锁定的叉乘。
Reading the missing triplet as a closed arc is this book's model, not a theorem.
把缺席的三元数读作闭合的圆弧体，是本书的模型，不是定理。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Geometric Intuition of Quantum Computing, chapter thirty-two.
《量子计算的几何直觉》· 第三十二章
